topics.title: Comprehension, Essay Writing, Sound System, Grammar, and Translation

subtopics.content: Reading comprehension passages, 300-word essays (narrative, descriptive, argumentative, expository, dialogue, debate, letter writing), sound system (vowels, consonants, syllabic nasals, syllable structure, assimilation, elision, tone notation), grammar (word classes, word formation, basic/derived numerals, grammatical categories, phrases, clauses, sentence types), and English-Yoruba translation
subtopics.objective: Comprehend written Yoruba passages; write structured essays in standard Yoruba orthography; classify speech sounds, syllable structures, tone marks, and sound processes; analyze word classes, sentence structures, and grammatical categories; translate accurately between English and Yoruba.

topics.title: Literary Appreciation, Oral Literature, and Written Literature

subtopics.content: Principles of literary appreciation, set oral literature texts (oral prose: *Àkójọpọ̀ Àlọ́ Ìjàpá*, oral drama: *Eégún Aláré*, oral poetry: *Ojúlówó Oríki Ifá*), and set written literature texts (written prose: *Ogún Ọmọdé*, written poetry: *Èdè Abínibí àti Àwọn Àròfọ̀ Miíràn*, written drama: *Ọ̀tẹ̀ Ọyẹ̀*)
subtopics.objective: Apply literary appreciation principles; critique prescribed oral literature prose, drama, and poetry texts; analyze themes, plot, characterization, and poetic devices in prescribed written prose, poetry, and drama texts.

sections.sectionTitle: Section C: Culture (Àṣà na Ètò Ìlú)

subtopics.content: Yoruba customs (adornment, games, pregnancy care, naming, home training/greetings, traditional foods, non-verbal communication, funeral rites, inheritance) and institutions (occupations, marriage, political organization, age grades, chieftaincy/Obaship, child care, religious beliefs regarding Olodumare and Orisa, modern religions, trade/cooperative practices)
subtopics.objective: Explain Yoruba cultural customs, life-cycle ceremonies, moral training, and traditional etiquette; analyze traditional Yoruba political, economic, social, and religious institutions.
